items.title: Menopause doesn't shrink the brain the way puberty and pregnancy remodel it
items.summary: Amsterdam UMC researchers publishing in Nature Communications compared brain scans of people before, during and after the menopause transition and found no overall drop in cortical grey matter. Unlike puberty and pregnancy, the menopause transition itself showed minimal grey-matter change, which suggests sex hormones act on the brain differently at different life stages.
items.sowhat: A 'menopause myth vs science' carousel: your brain isn't shrinking, and neither is your right to pleasure. Pair it with Nancy's 40+ pleasure tips.

items.title: 15-year beetle study: more partners, healthier genes
items.summary: A University of East Anglia study in PNAS followed red flour beetles for 15 years and found that when females mated with several males, offspring carried fewer harmful mutations. Those populations were healthier and more resistant to extinction, with no loss of genetic diversity.
items.sowhat: A cheeky 'science says variety is healthy' post (beetles only, of course) that leads into a 'try something new tonight' toy roundup.
items.source: University of East Anglia via Newswise

items.title: Testosterone prescriptions for women are rising, and so are denials
items.summary: Reuters reports that more menopausal women are being prescribed testosterone, often for low libido, even though the US still has no FDA-approved testosterone product for women. Patients describe insurance denials, pharmacy delays and off-label workarounds as demand grows faster than access.
items.sowhat: An explainer on 'what low libido in menopause actually is, and what helps', framing desire as healthcare rather than an afterthought.

items.title: Utah's 2% adult-content excise tax takes effect October 1
items.summary: Utah SB73 imposes a 2% excise tax on revenue from adult digital images, video or audio sold to Utah users, on top of the state's existing age-verification duties, with civil penalties for noncompliance.
items.sowhat: If Nancy sells or licenses any explicit digital content, not just physical toys, to Utah customers, confirm tax registration with finance before October 1.

items.title: Ofcom opens formal investigation into Pornhub's age-assurance system
items.summary: Ofcom launched an Online Safety Act investigation into Aylo (Pornhub's owner) over whether its Apple-device-based age check, rolled out in May 2026, is 'highly effective' at blocking minors; penalties can reach £18m or 10% of global turnover.
items.sowhat: UK regulators are now scrutinizing device-signal shortcuts, not just document checks, so audit whatever age-assurance method gates any UK-facing adult content or storefront.

items.title: Louisiana age-verification law reshapes live video chat services
items.summary: New reporting details how Louisiana's age-verification statute is forcing changes to live video chat and streaming services that operate with or near adult content in the state.
items.sowhat: If Nancy ever runs livestream shopping or creator live-chat features, confirm Louisiana-specific age-gating before targeting that state.
